why: Both land on the key's superstore-by-region hedgehog with profit per region, the format and acquisition stop-doing items, and the capital-bet and struggling-chain brutal facts; Analysis 2 adds the full-service and operating-systems elements and decline warnings closer to the key (diversifying out of electronics, expansion outrunning the manager bench). Analysis 1 has the tighter one-screen verdict and a potential score closer to the outcome, but Analysis 2 gives the leader more specific, testable actions with an explicit condition that would falsify the hedgehog.
